cards.say: How many halves make a whole? Two halves.

cards.say: How many quarters make a half? Two quarters.

cards.say: A quarter of four. One. Share four into four equal groups.
A quarter of eight. Two. Share eight into four equal groups.
A quarter of twelve. Three. Share twelve into four equal groups.
A quarter of sixteen. Four. Share sixteen into four equal groups.
A quarter of twenty. Five. Share twenty into four equal groups.

cards.front: Half a pizza is 4 slices. How many slices in the whole pizza?
cards.say: Half a pizza is four slices. How many slices in the whole pizza? Eight slices. Double four is eight.

cards.front: You fold a paper in half, then in half again. How many equal parts?
cards.say: You fold a paper in half, then in half again. How many equal parts? Four equal parts. They are quarters.

cards.front: Which is bigger: a half or a quarter of the same cake?
cards.back: A half. 2 quarters make a half.
cards.say: Which is bigger: a half or a quarter of the same cake? A half. Two quarters make a half.
